title: GNN-Guided Local Refinement for Efficient Layout Decomposition with DSA-MP
abstract: arXiv:2610.22214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multiple patterning lithography (MPL) has been widely used to improve lithography resolution in advanced nodes, but it faces cost limits as feature sizes shrink. Directed self-assembly (DSA) offers a cost-effective complement, extending the resolution of optical lithography to sub-10 nm and beyond. Integrating DSA into MPL (DSA-MP) further enhances the resolution of contact/via patterning. Nevertheless, growing design complexity exposes the limits of existing decomposition methods, which struggle to balance solution quality and runtime, and neglect edge-to-edge spacing constraints of DSA templates, compromising manufacturability. To address these issues, we introduce a new conflict graph model capturing the previously overlooked constraints and develop a local refinement strategy powered by the graph neural network, enabling efficient and scalable layout decomposition. translated_title: 基于GNN引导的局部优化实现DSA-MP高效版图分解
translated_abstract: 多重图案化光刻（MPL）已被广泛应用于先进工艺节点以提高光刻分辨率，但随着特征尺寸的不断缩小，其面临成本限制。定向自组装（DSA）作为一种经济高效的补充技术，可将光学光刻的分辨率扩展至10纳米以下甚至更小。将DSA集成到MPL（DSA-MP）中进一步提升了接触孔/通孔图案化的分辨率。然而，日益增长的设计复杂度暴露了现有分解方法的局限性：这些方法难以在解的质量与运行时间之间取得平衡，且忽视了DSA模板的边到边间距约束，从而损害了可制造性。为解决这些问题，我们引入了一种新的冲突图模型以捕捉此前被忽视的约束，并开发了一种由图神经网络驱动的局部优化策略，实现了高效且可扩展的版图分解。实验表明，我们的方法获得了更高的解质量……
tldr: 提出了一种捕捉DSA模板边到边间距约束的新冲突图模型，并结合图神经网络驱动的局部优化策略，实现了兼顾解质量与运行效率的DSA-MP版图分解。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel conflict graph model capturing previously overlooked edge-to-edge spacing constraints of DSA templates, combined with a GNN-guided local refinement strategy for efficient and scalable DSA-MP layout decomposition.
